name: gmsm-negotiated-padding-profiles-for-17b5
instr:
Add opt-in negotiated padding profiles so encrypted data carries enough authenticated information to select and reverse its padding safely. Support PKCS7, ANSI X923, ISO9797M2, ISO9797M3, and Zero consistently across block transforms, PKCS7 containers, and CFCA interoperability while preserving every unprofiled behavior and wire result.

Each built-in padding has a stable serialized identity, while caller-defined padding is never mistaken for a built-in profile. Resolution preserves each scheme's native rules: PKCS7 count filling, ANSI X923 zero filling, ISO9797M2 marker recovery, ISO9797M3 length-header validation, and Zero exact-length recovery. Zero-padded plaintext ending in zero bytes is recoverable only with matching authenticated original-length metadata. Profiled encryption atomically binds profile, block size, and any required original length to the ciphertext; randomness or metadata failure yields no partial container. Parsing retains unknown identities structurally, but inspection or decryption of unknown, malformed, inconsistent, or tampered metadata fails with `ErrPaddingProfile` from `github.com/emmansun/gmsm/padding` and returns no plaintext. `PaddingProfile` exposes only declared metadata before decryption, and existing PSK and recipient decryption dispatch the declared scheme without changing recipient or key handling. `ErrPaddingMetadata` and the transform APIs are exported from `github.com/emmansun/gmsm/cipher`; profiled construction and inspection are expo
